Verified on both sides and genuinely divergent. 23.07.03-band-treasury-member-distribution.md:29-32 states a closed set — 'one of three shapes … Equal / Weighted / Per-role'. The owning spec 01.04.03-treasury-mandate.md:25 states a different closed set — 'The distribution rule is one of exactly three shapes: equal (split N ways), by income share (the percentages fixed in 01.04.01), or manual per event' — and 23.07.03:102 plus 23.07-budgeting-project-tour-pl-index.md:48 both quote that enum as governing. 'Per-role' (a standing rule keyed to role) and 'manual per event' (an ad-hoc per-distribution entry) are not the same object, so the two enumerations cannot both be exhaustive. Downgraded from blocking because the conflict is not unmarked: 23.07.03:102 explicitly says 'The rule's shapes are fixed by [01.04.03] Behavior', which names the authority an implementer must follow — the defect is a stale Behavior section, not an absent decision. Unit is a SHOULD (moscow-ledger.md:485) at [PARTIAL], so it is in Step-5 scope.

Both quotes verified (23.04-deal-contract-vault-cx.md:31 and :51). They reconcile on the word the finding itself flags: CX-01 forbids an unconfirmed extraction from 'silently' driving an alert; CX-02 requires the alert to fire 'flagged as unconfirmed', which is by construction not silent. The owning feature states the same non-silent behaviour three times (23.04.03:45 'Fire anyway, flagged as unconfirmed', :61 'Unconfirmed dates alert anyway, flagged', :86 D-02), and 23.04.02:23 constrains only reconciliation findings, not alerts. Every reasonable reading builds one thing: alert fires, carrying an unconfirmed flag.

The Edge Case at 23.07.03:49 does still phrase the case as an open parent question, as quoted. But the behaviour it leaves open is settled in the same file: 23.07.03:102 Q-02 is RESOLVED — 'it discloses the default that already governs them rather than prompting a negotiation, and it never guesses a rule' — and the Edge Case's own 'What Happens' cell already states 'Nothing can be computed'. Those two together answer the finding's forced-invention question directly: no provisional distribution is computed, the legal default is disclosed (01.04.01 D-04, quoted at :102, 'disclosure of the default, not an agreement builder'), and the Empty state at :64 confirms this is a normal, non-error condition. Stale cross-reference wording, not an open product decision.
